content_sections.heading: Kaushambi Anganwadi Worker Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 143 Anganwadi Karyakartri posts are advertised across nine projects: 41 for Scheduled Caste, 30 for Other Backward Class and 72 for Unreserved candidates. The notification gives these project-wise figures. Detailed ward-wise and Gram Sabha-wise vacancy details with reservation and eligibility are available on the district notice boards and the departmental website (see below). The notification states that 194 Anganwadi centres of Kaushambi district (Chail 162, Nevada 32 and Muratganj 01, as written) are being merged into Prayagraj district and are in the process of being placed under Bhagwatpur development block of Prayagraj. Recruitment for vacant Anganwadi Karyakartri posts of these 194 centres will be conducted by Prayagraj district. The figures as printed add up to 195, not 194; the notification does not explain this difference.

content_sections.heading: Kaushambi Anganwadi Worker Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The notification lists these conditions for the advertised posts: Only women candidates are eligible. The candidate must be a permanent resident of the ward or Gram Sabha of the vacant post. If no eligible candidate of the required category is available in the Gram Sabha, the candidate must be a permanent resident of the concerned Nyay Panchayat. In urban areas, the online residence certificate issued by the tehsil at the time of applying must clearly show the relevant ward number or name. Candidates must meet the educational qualification and age limit given below. The notification also lists certificate rules; see the documents section below.

content_sections.heading: Kaushambi Anganwadi Worker Qualification
content_sections.text: The minimum educational qualification for all posts is Intermediate (Class 12) or an equivalent qualification. The merit list will be prepared on the basis of educational qualification, from the minimum of Intermediate or equivalent up to a maximum of postgraduate (as stated in the notification).

content_sections.heading: Kaushambi Anganwadi Worker Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification states that merit will be prepared on the basis of educational qualification, from Intermediate or equivalent up to postgraduate. It does not mention a written exam or interview. The selection committee takes the final decision on filling the posts. Information filled in the online application is used for selection, and no documents are accepted offline. The notification mentions a preference rule in the context of recruitment to the helper (Sahayika) post. Preference is given to applicants in the BPL (below poverty line) category, as determined under UP Social Welfare Section-2 Government Order No. 22/2015/26-2-2015 dated 14 September 2015 (as amended). The order of preference is: first, BPL widows; then, BPL legally divorced or abandoned women; and if no eligible applicant is available, women of BPL families on merit. If no BPL applicant is available, the same process applies to women above the poverty line. Confirm with the official notification whether this rule applies to the Karyakartri posts you are applying for.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kaushambi Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official portal https://www.upanganwadibharti.in. Fill in the online application form in the departmental format, carefully and accurately. Upload clear, legible, self-attested copies of the required records and mention them in the form. Submit the application on or before 21 October 2026, up to 12:00 midnight. Applications sent offline or by post will not be accepted in any case. If any detail, mark or percentage is found wrong or forged, the candidature will be cancelled.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the Kaushambi UP Anganwadi recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Kaushambi UP Anganwadi for filling various contractual positions across different blocks and areas within the Kaushambi district of Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in the Kaushambi UP Anganwadi recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 143 vacancies available for the post of Anganwadi Worker distributed across various project areas including Sirathu, Manjhanpur, Kara, and others.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for Kaushambi UP Anganwadi recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Kaushambi UP Anganwadi recruitment 2026 is 21 October 2026. Candidates should apply early to avoid server congestion.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for Kaushambi UP Anganwadi Worker posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Anganwadi Worker posts must have passed Intermediate (Class 12th) or an equivalent examination from a recognized board or institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to Kaushambi UP Anganwadi recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The candidate's age must be between 18 years and 35 years. Age relaxations and preferences are provided to specific categories like BPL widows and deserted women as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Kaushambi UP Anganwadi recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, and ST categories. The application fee is Nil for all eligible applicants.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for Kaushambi UP Anganwadi Worker posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be based strictly on a merit list prepared according to the educational qualifications of the applicants across their academic journey.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for Kaushambi UP Anganwadi recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly online. Interested candidates must submit their applications through the designated official web portal provided for UP Anganwadi recruitments.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification PDF for Kaushambi UP Anganwadi recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF by visiting the official website at https://www.upanganwadibharti.in or by checking the important links section provided in this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for Kaushambi UP Anganwadi Worker positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is purely contractual under the state government guidelines for the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) scheme in Uttar Pradesh.
